headline: Bank Indonesia Hikes Benchmark Interest Rate by 25 Basis Points to 6%
summary: Bank Indonesia increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 6.0 per cent in an effort to support the weakening rupiah.
why: Central bank rate adjustments are primary monetary policy tools used to defend domestic currency values and manage domestic inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Bank Indonesia Benchmark Rate
impacts.why: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark rate by 25 bps to 6%.
